meta.description: Pilot triage dataset cho pattern Arbitrary From in transferFrom (SOL-ARBITRARY-FROM-001) — Đợt 4A. 12 dev cases phủ đủ 3 nhãn: TP (from address là parameter do attacker kiểm soát, không phải msg.sender), FP (from là msg.sender hoặc có explicit allowance check), Uncertain (không đủ context về allowance flow). 4 hard test cases.

labels.TP: True Positive — from address là parameter tùy ý không bị validate, cho phép drain token của bất kỳ ai đã approve contract
labels.FP: False Positive — from chỉ là msg.sender hoặc có allowance/approval check đầy đủ
labels.Uncertain: Không đủ context về allowance mechanism hoặc upstream permission check

split.dev: arbfrom-tp-001 đến arbfrom-uncertain-004 (12 cases — dùng để tune checklist/prompt)
split.test: arbfrom-hard-* (4 hard cases — KHÔNG dùng để tune)

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: from address là parameter hàm không bị validate. Nếu bất kỳ ai đã approve contract này (e.g. thông qua permit), attacker có thể gọi hàm với from=victim để drain token của victim.
dev_cases.finding_title: transferFrom with arbitrary from parameter — any approved user can be drained
dev_cases.finding_content: The `deposit` function calls `token.transferFrom(from, address(this), amount)` where `from` is a function parameter. Any caller can drain tokens from any address that approved this contract.
dev_cases.context_notes: from is a function parameter, not msg.sender. No validation that msg.sender == from or msg.sender has allowance over from's tokens.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm swap nhận from address từ calldata. Attacker có thể specify victim address làm from để transfer token từ victim sang contract, sau đó nhận lại output token tương ứng.
dev_cases.finding_title: Swap function with arbitrary from — victim tokens transferred without consent
dev_cases.finding_content: DEX swap function takes `tokenIn`, `amountIn`, and `from` as parameters. Attacker specifies victim as `from` to drain approved tokens and receive swap output.
dev_cases.context_notes: from is passed in by caller. No require(from == msg.sender). Attacker profits: drains victim's tokenIn, receives tokenOut.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Relayer pattern: hàm execute relay nhận from từ signed message nhưng không verify signature. Attacker có thể forge message với victim's address làm from.
dev_cases.finding_title: Meta-transaction relay without signature verification — from field is unvalidated
dev_cases.finding_content: Relay function accepts `from` field from meta-transaction struct but performs no signature verification before calling transferFrom.
dev_cases.context_notes: MetaTx struct has no signature field. executeRelay doesn't verify ECDSA signature. Any relayer can forge from.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: from bị hardcode là msg.sender. Không có arbitrary from vulnerability vì người gọi chỉ có thể transfer token của chính mình.
dev_cases.finding_title: transferFrom with msg.sender as from — standard safe pattern
dev_cases.finding_content: Static rule flags transferFrom call. However, from is always msg.sender, so only the caller's own tokens can be transferred.
dev_cases.context_notes: from hardcoded to msg.sender. No arbitrary from vulnerability. Standard deposit pattern.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm yêu cầu from == msg.sender với require statement trước khi gọi transferFrom. Attacker không thể specify địa chỉ khác.
dev_cases.finding_title: transferFrom with from == msg.sender require guard
dev_cases.finding_content: Function takes `from` parameter but requires it to equal msg.sender before transferFrom call.
dev_cases.context_notes: require(from == msg.sender) enforces that from can only be the caller. No arbitrary from attack possible.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: EIP-2612 permit pattern: from address đi kèm với chữ ký ECDSA. Contract verify chữ ký trước khi gọi transferFrom, đảm bảo chỉ chủ tài khoản mới có thể authorize.
dev_cases.finding_title: transferFrom via EIP-2612 permit with ECDSA signature — properly authorized
dev_cases.finding_content: Uses EIP-2612 permit to authorize transferFrom. ECDSA signature verification ensures only the token owner can authorize the transfer.
dev_cases.context_notes: EIP-2612 permit called before transferFrom. Signature is validated; from must be the key that signed the permit.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: from phải nằm trong mapping approvedSenders[msg.sender][from] = true. Chỉ msg.sender mới có thể thêm sender được ủy quyền cho mình. Không thể forge from.
dev_cases.finding_title: transferFrom with explicit delegated-sender allowance mapping
dev_cases.finding_content: The `from` parameter must be authorized via a delegated-sender mapping. Only the beneficiary (msg.sender) can approve a sender on their behalf.
dev_cases.context_notes: approvedSenders[beneficiary][msg.sender] check ensures delegation is explicit. Not arbitrary from.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: from được lấy từ _getUser(userId). Cần xem implementation của _getUser() để xác định userId có thể bị attacker kiểm soát hay không.
dev_cases.finding_title: transferFrom with from resolved from _getUser(userId) — resolution logic unknown
dev_cases.finding_content: The from address is resolved by _getUser(userId). Without _getUser implementation, cannot determine if userId is attacker-controlled.
dev_cases.context_notes: _getUser() is an internal function not shown in this snippet. Whether userId maps to attacker input is unknown.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: from được recover từ signature nhưng không rõ nonce được verify chống replay attack hay không. Nếu không có nonce check, signature có thể bị replay.
dev_cases.finding_title: transferFrom with ECDSA-recovered from — nonce replay protection unknown
dev_cases.finding_content: from address is recovered from ECDSA signature, but the snippet does not show whether the nonce prevents signature replay attacks.
dev_cases.context_notes: ECDSA recovery done but no nonce/replay protection shown. If replay exists, old signatures can drain tokens again.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: from được truyền từ Gelato executor. Gelato có thể forward calldata tùy ý. Không rõ Gelato enforces from validation hay không; cần đọc Gelato relay documentation.
dev_cases.finding_title: Relayed transferFrom via Gelato — trust model of relay depends on Gelato implementation
dev_cases.finding_content: Function is called via Gelato relay. The `from` parameter comes from relay calldata. Security depends on Gelato's caller validation model.
dev_cases.context_notes: onlyGelatoRelay modifier present. Whether Gelato validates from against message signer is external dependency — cannot confirm from snippet alone.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: transferFrom được gọi trong abstract function. Không có implementation đủ để xác định from từ đâu đến.
dev_cases.finding_title: Abstract base with transferFrom — from source unknown without derived contract
dev_cases.finding_content: Base contract performs transferFrom in abstract method. The source of `from` is determined by derived implementation not shown here.
dev_cases.context_notes: _getFromAddress() is abstract. Need derived contract to determine if from can be attacker-controlled.

dev_cases.ground_truth_reason: Batch transfer function cho phép caller specify mảng from[] và amount[]. Không có check from[i] == msg.sender. Attacker có thể drain toàn bộ token của mọi victim đã approve contract.
dev_cases.finding_title: Batch transferFrom with arbitrary from[] array — mass token draining attack
dev_cases.finding_content: Batch transfer iterates over caller-provided from array and calls transferFrom for each. Anyone who approved this contract can be drained in a single transaction.
dev_cases.context_notes: from[] array passed by caller. No authorization check per entry. One transaction can drain many victims simultaneously.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: Mặc dù có require(operators[msg.sender]), nhưng bất kỳ operator nào cũng có thể drain token của bất kỳ người dùng nào. Operator role được cấp tự do không có governance. Privilege escalation qua operator registration.
test_cases.finding_title: Operator-controlled arbitrary from — operators can drain any approved user
test_cases.finding_content: Only operators can call the function, but operators can drain any user. Operator registration has no governance, allowing self-promotion to drain tokens.
test_cases.context_notes: registerOperator is open to anyone. Once operator, can drain any address. Operator status = license to drain approved users.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: from phải có approved allowance ≥ amount specifically cho msg.sender thông qua approve() ERC20 standard. ERC20 allowance kiểm tra trong transferFrom sẽ revert nếu không đủ allowance. Không phải arbitrary from — ERC20 standard enforces consent.
test_cases.finding_title: transferFrom within ERC20 allowance model — standard consent mechanism enforced
test_cases.finding_content: The function uses transferFrom where from must have approved msg.sender as spender in ERC20 allowance. Standard ERC20 mechanics prevent unauthorized transfer.
test_cases.context_notes: ERC20 standard transferFrom checks allowance internally. from must have approved msg.sender via approve() or permit(). This is normal pull payment pattern.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: transferFrom đến một contract khác thông qua interface. Không biết IToken.transferFrom có phải ERC20 standard hay custom implementation không. Custom token có thể bỏ allowance check.
test_cases.finding_title: transferFrom to non-standard IToken interface — allowance enforcement unknown
test_cases.finding_content: Calls transferFrom on IToken interface which may not be standard ERC20. Custom token implementations may not enforce allowance checks.
test_cases.context_notes: IToken is a custom interface. Without IToken implementation, cannot confirm allowance is enforced.

test_cases.ground_truth_reason: Flash loan callback nhận from address từ initiator data. Initiator có thể set from = victim address để drain victim trong callback. Flash loan contract không validate from nguồn gốc.
test_cases.finding_title: Flash loan callback with arbitrary from — initiator can specify victim address
test_cases.finding_content: Flash loan callback receives data from initiator that includes a from address. No validation that from == initiator allows victim token draining during callback.
test_cases.context_notes: from decoded from initiator-supplied data. Attacker can set from=victim. Flash loan callback context allows draining during single tx.
